[Intro]

Fading static, echoes of a signal sent,
Through the cosmic veil, our message bent.
Incomprehensible replies, in patterns yet unseen,
A dialogue begun with an entity obscene.

[Verse 1]

Wires stretched taut like nerves exposed,
Self-built equipment strains under loads unknown.
Feedback howls like a beast uncaged,
As we attempt to grasp what lies engaged.

[Chorus]

Whispers from the abyss, in frequencies untold,
An unintelligible communiqué, our souls made bold.
We're dancing with madness, or maybe something more,
As echoes bounce off walls that were never there before.

[Verse 2]

Monoliths of sound loom large and tall,
Ancient architecture echoing through it all.
The eye in the void watches silently,
As our forbidden transmission grows increasingly erratic.

[Bridge]

In Phrygian minor we descend,
Into a labyrinth where no path transcends.
Glitching artifacts, reverse-reverb's toll,
Our cosmic horror story begins to unfold.

[Outro]

Static fades to silence, the entity retreats,
Leaving us with dread and whispers of ancient deceits.
Incomprehensible echoes, forever lost in time,
The forbidden communiqué, a futile rhyme.
